# Synopsis: *Revenant*
### Book One of The Shadow War Chronicles

**Author**: Raymond Bayly  
**Series**: *The Shadow War Chronicles* (Book 1 of 9)  
**Genre**: Military Sci-Fi / Space Opera  
**Length**: ~109,473 words · 42 Chapters  
**Formats Available**: PDF, EPUB, MOBI, DOCX  

---

## Part I: Retail Back Cover Blurb

> **“Well, we are truly screwed,”** Captain Blake Campbell muttered, squinting against the harsh bridge lights as he eyed the fleet standing sentry outside the station dock.
> 
> They hung in the void like sharks stalking an easy meal—twenty-five black-hulled dreadnoughts waiting to blow his ship to scrap.
> 
> A grim smile spread across Blake’s face as he slowly extended his middle finger against the viewport. 
> 
> *Funny how things work out. Two months ago, I was drinking cheap beer by a mountain lake back on Earth... then that damn ship showed up.*

***

extra.section_header: He went to the mountains to hide from his demons. The universe had other plans.
